states.NO_DURABLE_EVIDENCE: no invocation is qualified; Work-only preview, no session read
states.SELECTED_UNIQUE: exactly one qualified invocation and no unresolved alternative; selected automatically
states.SELECTED_REQUESTED: the caller named an invocation that is qualified
states.AMBIGUOUS_REQUIRES_SELECTION: several invocations are qualified; an explicit invocationId is required
states.REQUESTED_NOT_QUALIFIED: the requested invocation belongs to this attempt but is not qualified
states.REQUESTED_FOREIGN: the requested invocation does not belong to this attempt

rules: a caller-supplied invocationId is a SELECTOR, never authority
the latest invocation is never auto-selected
a caller Claim never becomes the read authority
a hostRecord.portInvocationId is never proof of invocation ownership
tests: P2C C3 §8.3 with no durable evidence a requested invocation selector is refused
P2C §11.5 several qualified invocations require explicit selection
P2C C5 §8.3 a caller Claim never becomes the read authority
